name: Dual Contouring with NDC Constraint
definition: A mesh extraction technique that generates vertices and triangles from integer grid data (LOD_gt_int) and floating-point position data (LOD_gt_float), enforcing constraints via a least-squares solver with regularization to keep vertex positions within [0,1] bounds before mapping to grid coordinates.
summary: Dual Contouring with NDC Constraint extracts polygonal meshes from grid data, using iterative scale adjustment to keep vertices within normalized device coordinates, unlike standard dual contouring.
